spans.s: (I)--learnt the Atharva सम्हिता from a pupil of Sumantu; Kumuda and others were his disciples. भा.
(II)--a disciple of Kabandha; he had three dis- ciples; जाजलि (जाबालि-वि। प्।), कुमुलादि and शौनक. Br. II. ३५. ५६, ५९; वा. ६१. ५०; Vi.
--a daughter of Maru and wife of Atharva An- giras; father of १०१ sons of whom were अयास्य, वामदेव, Utathya, उशिति, and धृष्णि. Br.
--a kind of fish used in the श्राद्धस्. M. १५. ३४. [page२-313+ ३३]
